Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a transaction fee to fund an electronic pawnbroker and second-hand dealer reporting system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an electronic reporting system for pawnbrokersand second-hand dealers; amending RCW 19.60.060; adding a new sectionto chapter 19.60 RCW; creating a new section; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The chief of police may require pawnbrokers and secondhanddealers to collect a fee, not to exceed ten dollars or the actual pertransaction cost, whichever is less, for each transaction for whicheach pawnbroker or secondhand dealer is required to record informationunder RCW 19.60.020. The county's chief law enforcement officer mayrequire pawnbrokers and secondhand dealers to pay the transaction feefor pawnbrokers and secondhand dealers having their registered placeof business in the unincorporated area of a county. (2) Every month pawnbrokers and secondhand dealers required tocollect the transaction fee under subsection (1) of this section shallremit the transaction fee to the city or county treasurer. The city orcounty treasurer shall deposit the money in a special account to be p. 1 SB 5494used by the law enforcement agency only for establishing andmaintaining an electronic pawnbroker and secondhand dealer transactionreporting system. (3) A law enforcement agency collecting the fee authorized undersubsection (1) of this section shall adopt the electronic reportingsystem recommended by the Washington association of sheriffs and policechiefs.

The Washington association of sheriffs andpolice chiefs shall convene a work group of law enforcement officers toidentify and by July 1, 2004, recommend an electronic pawnbroker andsecondhand dealer transaction reporting system.
